# AnyDag sync API

<!-- Generated by `npm run openapi` from the code; `npm run checks` fails when it is stale. Do not edit. -->

Version 2 · OpenAPI 3.1.0 · the document: [`sync.openapi.json`](sync.openapi.json)

`anydag-api`: end-to-end-encrypted sync, opt-in anonymous logs and the feedback relay, one Node process anybody can run (`api/` in the AnyDag repository).

The server holds opaque keys, sealed blobs and sealed metadata, and never a path or a byte of a file: a `key` is an HMAC of a path, a blob id an HMAC of the bytes, a `meta` and a vault's `name` are sealed, all base64url.

`info.version` is the sync protocol, 2. Every request to a route that lists the `anydag-sync-protocol` header must send it, and every `/v1` answer says it back. A refusal is `{code, message}` at the status its `ES_*` code has, whatever the route; branch on the code.

Generated from the code (`api/server/openapi.ts`, `api/protocol/schema.ts`): do not edit it by hand.

## devices

Pairing a device, and the account's devices.

<a id="op-pair"></a>

### `POST /v1/pair`

**Pair a device with a one-time code.** The code is the credential: ten Crockford base32 characters, used once, dead after fifteen minutes. A bad, used and expired code are one answer. The device limit is checked after the code is taken, so a refused pairing spends it.

Token: none. Operation id: `pair`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `anydag-sync-protocol` | header | string | yes | The sync protocol this client speaks; any other, or none, is `ES_PROTOCOL`. |

Body (`application/json`): [`PairRequest`](#schema-pairrequest).

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | [`PairResponse`](#schema-pairresponse) | The device token, shown once. |
| 400 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_BAD_REQUEST"` or `"ES_PAIR"` } | `ES_BAD_REQUEST`: a body or a query that does not have the shape this document gives. `ES_PAIR`: a pairing code that is unknown, used or expired. |
| 413 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_QUOTA"` } | `ES_QUOTA`: over the plan: storage, a file's size, or the number of devices. |
| 426 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_PROTOCOL"` } | `ES_PROTOCOL`: the request did not say sync protocol 2 in `anydag-sync-protocol`. |
| 500 | [`ServerError`](#schema-servererror) | The server failed; the stack is on its stderr, never here. |

## log

Each vault's gapless log of commits, and its heads.

<a id="op-commit"></a>

### `POST /v1/vaults/{v}/commit`

**Commit changes, all or nothing.** Accepted only if every change's `parent` is its key's head. A refusal names what to do next: `ES_STALE` every conflicting key and its head, `ES_NO_BLOB` the blobs to upload. Nothing is written in either case.

Token: `device` (A device token, from `POST /v1/pair`: 43 base64url characters, shown once). Operation id: `commit`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `v` | path | string, matching `^[0-9a-z]{10}$` | yes | The vault's id: ten characters of lower-case Crockford base32. |
| `anydag-sync-protocol` | header | string | yes | The sync protocol this client speaks; any other, or none, is `ES_PROTOCOL`. |

Body (`application/json`): [`CommitRequest`](#schema-commitrequest).

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | [`CommitResponse`](#schema-commitresponse) | The `seq` of each change. |
| 400 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_BAD_REQUEST"` } | `ES_BAD_REQUEST`: a body or a query that does not have the shape this document gives. |
| 401 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_AUTH"` } | `ES_AUTH`: no device token, an unknown one, or a revoked device's. |
| 404 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_NOT_FOUND"` } | `ES_NOT_FOUND`: no such vault, blob, device, account or plan. |
| 409 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_STALE"` } | `ES_STALE`: a change's `parent` is not its key's head; nothing was written (`conflicts`). |
| 413 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_QUOTA"` } | `ES_QUOTA`: over the plan: storage, a file's size, or the number of devices. |
| 422 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_NO_BLOB"` } | `ES_NO_BLOB`: a commit names a blob the server does not hold; upload first (`missing`). |
| 426 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_PROTOCOL"` } | `ES_PROTOCOL`: the request did not say sync protocol 2 in `anydag-sync-protocol`. |
| 500 | [`ServerError`](#schema-servererror) | The server failed; the stack is on its stderr, never here. |

<a id="op-changes"></a>

### `GET /v1/vaults/{v}/changes`

**The log after a cursor.** A cursor below the horizon has missed compacted rows and is refused `ES_HORIZON`: read the heads instead. `more` is `next < head`, never whether the page came back full.

Token: `device` (A device token, from `POST /v1/pair`: 43 base64url characters, shown once). Operation id: `changes`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `v` | path | string, matching `^[0-9a-z]{10}$` | yes | The vault's id: ten characters of lower-case Crockford base32. |
| `since` | query | integer, ≥ 0, default `0` | no | Entries with a `seq` above this one. |
| `limit` | query | integer, ≥ 1, ≤ 1000, default `1000` | no | The most entries in the page. |
| `anydag-sync-protocol` | header | string | yes | The sync protocol this client speaks; any other, or none, is `ES_PROTOCOL`. |

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | [`ChangesResponse`](#schema-changesresponse) | A page of the log. |
| 400 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_BAD_REQUEST"` } | `ES_BAD_REQUEST`: a body or a query that does not have the shape this document gives. |
| 401 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_AUTH"` } | `ES_AUTH`: no device token, an unknown one, or a revoked device's. |
| 404 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_NOT_FOUND"` } | `ES_NOT_FOUND`: no such vault, blob, device, account or plan. |
| 410 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_HORIZON"` } | `ES_HORIZON`: a cursor older than the compaction horizon; read the heads (`horizon`). |
| 426 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_PROTOCOL"` } | `ES_PROTOCOL`: the request did not say sync protocol 2 in `anydag-sync-protocol`. |
| 500 | [`ServerError`](#schema-servererror) | The server failed; the stack is on its stderr, never here. |

<a id="op-heads"></a>

### `GET /v1/vaults/{v}/heads`

**Every key's head, a page at a time.** A device that reads every page and then pulls `changes?since=<the first page's seq>` has missed nothing.

Token: `device` (A device token, from `POST /v1/pair`: 43 base64url characters, shown once). Operation id: `heads`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `v` | path | string, matching `^[0-9a-z]{10}$` | yes | The vault's id: ten characters of lower-case Crockford base32. |
| `after` | query | string, 0 to 64 characters | no | The key to start after: the last page's `next`. |
| `limit` | query | integer, ≥ 1, ≤ 1000, default `1000` | no | The most heads in the page. |
| `anydag-sync-protocol` | header | string | yes | The sync protocol this client speaks; any other, or none, is `ES_PROTOCOL`. |

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | [`HeadsResponse`](#schema-headsresponse) | A page of heads. |
| 400 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_BAD_REQUEST"` } | `ES_BAD_REQUEST`: a body or a query that does not have the shape this document gives. |
| 401 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_AUTH"` } | `ES_AUTH`: no device token, an unknown one, or a revoked device's. |
| 404 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_NOT_FOUND"` } | `ES_NOT_FOUND`: no such vault, blob, device, account or plan. |
| 426 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_PROTOCOL"` } | `ES_PROTOCOL`: the request did not say sync protocol 2 in `anydag-sync-protocol`. |
| 500 | [`ServerError`](#schema-servererror) | The server failed; the stack is on its stderr, never here. |

<a id="op-poke"></a>

### `GET /v1/vaults/{v}/poke`

**Hear about commits as they land.** A server-sent event stream: `data: {"seq":N}` after each commit to the vault and a `: ping` comment every 20 s. It carries a number and nothing else: a client reads `changes` either way, so a lost poke costs a poll interval, never a change.

Token: `device` (A device token, from `POST /v1/pair`: 43 base64url characters, shown once). Operation id: `poke`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `v` | path | string, matching `^[0-9a-z]{10}$` | yes | The vault's id: ten characters of lower-case Crockford base32. |

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | `text/event-stream` | The stream, open until the client goes. |
| 204 | none | This server does not poke (`ANYDAG_API_POKE=off`): poll. |
| 401 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_AUTH"` } | `ES_AUTH`: no device token, an unknown one, or a revoked device's. |
| 404 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_NOT_FOUND"` } | `ES_NOT_FOUND`: no such vault, blob, device, account or plan. |
| 500 | [`ServerError`](#schema-servererror) | The server failed; the stack is on its stderr, never here. |

## logs

Anonymous logs from installs that said yes. No token.

<a id="op-logs"></a>

### `POST /v1/logs`

**Send anonymous logs.** Open: an install that sends logs is usually not a device of this server. A batch over the size cap, the per-address rate or the server's is answered `{accepted: 0}` and dropped, never an error a client would retry; one that is not JSON is `ES_BAD_REQUEST`.

Token: none. Operation id: `logs`.

Body (`application/json`): [`LogBatch`](#schema-logbatch).

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 202 | [`LogsAccepted`](#schema-logsaccepted) | How many events were kept. |
| 400 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_BAD_REQUEST"` } | `ES_BAD_REQUEST`: a body or a query that does not have the shape this document gives. |
| 500 | [`ServerError`](#schema-servererror) | The server failed; the stack is on its stderr, never here. |

## feedback

The feedback relay. No token.

<a id="op-feedback"></a>

### `POST /v1/feedback`

**Send a bug or an idea, made a GitHub issue.** Stateless: nothing of it is kept. Every file is uploaded before the issue is made, so a failed upload makes no issue. Five a minute an address, sixty in all.

Token: none. Operation id: `feedback`.

Body (`multipart/form-data`): [`FeedbackForm`](#schema-feedbackform).

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 201 | [`FeedbackSent`](#schema-feedbacksent) | The issue. |
| 400 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_BAD_REQUEST"` } | `ES_BAD_REQUEST`: a body or a query that does not have the shape this document gives. |
| 413 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_TOO_LARGE"` } | `ES_TOO_LARGE`: feedback bigger than the relay reads. |
| 429 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_RATE"` } | `ES_RATE`: over a rate: try again in a minute. |
| 500 | [`ServerError`](#schema-servererror) | The server failed; the stack is on its stderr, never here. |
| 502 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_UPSTREAM"` } | `ES_UPSTREAM`: GitHub refused or failed; no issue was made. |
| 503 | [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody), with { code: `"ES_UNAVAILABLE"` } | `ES_UNAVAILABLE`: this server has no GitHub token or repository for the relay. |

| `features.feedback` | boolean | yes |  |

|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string, matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$` | yes |  |
| `parent` | integer, ≥ 1, or `null` | yes | The `seq` of the head this change was based on — a delete's too — or `null` for a key that has never had one. |
| `blob` | string, matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$`, or `null` | yes | The new content's blob, or `null` for a delete. |
| `meta` | string, 0 to 65536 characters | yes | Sealed with this change's key, blob and parent inside it. |

<a id="schema-commitresponse"></a>

### `CommitResponse`

The `seq` given to each change, in order.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `seqs` | list of integer, ≥ 1 | yes |  |

<a id="schema-changesresponse"></a>

### `ChangesResponse`

Entries with `seq > since`, ascending.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `changes` | list of [`LogEntry`](#schema-logentry) | yes |  |
| `next` | integer, ≥ 0 | yes | The cursor to ask with next: the last `seq` returned, or `since` when none was. |
| `more` | boolean | yes | Whether more entries are waiting past `next`. |
| `head` | integer, ≥ 0 | yes | The vault's last `seq`. |
| `horizon` | integer, ≥ 0 | yes | The lowest `seq` still in the log. |

<a id="schema-logentry"></a>

### `LogEntry`

A row of the log as it is read back.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `seq` | integer, ≥ 1 | yes |  |
| `key` | string | yes |  |
| `parent` | integer, ≥ 1, or `null` | yes |  |
| `blob` | string, matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$`, or `null` | yes |  |
| `size` | integer, ≥ 0 | yes | The sealed blob's size in bytes, 0 for a delete. |
| `meta` | string | yes |  |
| `device` | string | yes | The device that committed it: a client skips its own. |
| `at` | string | yes |  |

<a id="schema-headsresponse"></a>

### `HeadsResponse`

A page of heads in key order, deletes included. `seq` is the vault's last when the page was read.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `heads` | list of [`Head`](#schema-head) | yes |  |
| `next` | string, or `null` | yes | The `after` to ask with next, `null` on the last page. |
| `seq` | integer, ≥ 0 | yes |  |

<a id="schema-head"></a>

### `Head`

A key's current state.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes |  |
| `seq` | integer, ≥ 1 | yes |  |
| `parent` | integer, ≥ 1, or `null` | yes | The `parent` of the change that made this head: what its sealed `meta` is bound to. |
| `blob` | string, matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$`, or `null` | yes |  |
| `size` | integer, ≥ 0 | yes |  |
| `meta` | string | yes |  |

<a id="schema-logbatch"></a>

### `LogBatch`

Logs from an install that said yes, in `protocol/logs.ts`' closed vocabulary. Whatever it cannot describe is dropped, never refused: an unknown event or prop, a bad time, a batch with no event left.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `v` | `1` | yes |  |
| `env` | { version, shell, os, arch, locale, install } | yes |  |
| `env.version` | string, matching `^[0-9A-Za-z.+-]{1,32}$` | yes |  |
| `env.shell` | `"desktop"` or `"browser"` | yes |  |
| `env.os` | `"linux"` or `"darwin"` or `"win32"` or `"other"` | yes |  |
| `env.arch` | `"x64"` or `"arm64"` or `"other"` | yes |  |
| `env.locale` | string, matching `^[a-z]{2,3}(-[A-Z]{2})?$` | yes | A language, and a region when there is one. |
| `env.install` | string, matching `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$` | yes | A random id made when somebody said yes. |
| `events` | list of { name, at, props } or { name, at, props } or { name, at, props } or { name, at, props } or { name, at, props } or { name, at, props } | yes | Up to 200 are read; the rest are dropped. |

<a id="schema-logsaccepted"></a>

### `LogsAccepted`

How many events were kept: the whole batch, or none (over a rate, a cap, or nothing left once cleaned).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `accepted` | integer, ≥ 0 | yes |  |

<a id="schema-feedbackform"></a>

### `FeedbackForm`

A person's bug or idea. The caps are `protocol/feedback.ts`' (everything together at most 10 MB, five files, five boards and notes), which the page and the app's server hold too.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `"bug"` or `"idea"` | yes |  |
| `text` | string, 1 to 20000 characters | yes | The person's own words. |
| `boards` | list of [`FeedbackDoc`](#schema-feedbackdoc) | no | JSON: the boards that were ticked. |
| `notes` | list of [`FeedbackDoc`](#schema-feedbackdoc) | no | JSON: the notes that were ticked. |
| `env` | { version, os, arch } | no | JSON: the version, the system and the arch. A value that is not one short word is kept as `unknown`. |
| `env.version` | string | yes |  |
| `env.os` | string | yes |  |
| `env.arch` | string | yes |  |
| `files` | list of string, `application/octet-stream` | no | Pictures, videos, PDFs or text files. |

<a id="schema-feedbackdoc"></a>

### `FeedbackDoc`

A board or note that was ticked: its name and its whole text.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string, 0 to 200 characters | yes |  |
| `text` | string, 0 to 200000 characters | yes |  |

<a id="schema-feedbacksent"></a>

### `FeedbackSent`

The issue the feedback became.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | yes |  |
